commands.name: add
commands.description: Add a UPM package by name@version, git URL, or 'file:' local path. Async by default (returns in_progress; poll package status); pass wait=true to block until added. A recompile/domain reload follows — poll script recompile_status. Requires confirm=true; use dry_run to preview.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Package to add: 'com.unity.foo@1.2.3', a git URL, or 'file:../Path'.

parameters.name: confirm
parameters.description: Apply the change. Without it the call is refused.

parameters.name: dry_run
parameters.description: Preview the change without applying it.

parameters.name: wait
parameters.description: Block until the operation completes and return the result (synchronous). Default: return immediately and poll package status.

commands.name: attach
commands.description: Add a MonoBehaviour to a GameObject by its (compiled) type name OR by its script asset path. Provide exactly one of 'type' or 'script'. If the type isn't compiled yet, returns a recoverable error: script recompile, poll script recompile_status, then retry.

parameters.name: target
parameters.description: Reference to the GameObject to add the component to (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath).

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Component type name to add, e.g. PlayerController or Game.Player.PlayerController. Must already be compiled. Mutually exclusive with 'script'.

parameters.name: script
parameters.description: Script asset path, e.g. 'Assets/Pool/Scripts/CueShooter.cs'. The backing class is resolved via MonoScript.GetClass(), so the class name may differ from the filename. Mutually exclusive with 'type'.

schema.title: script attach
schema.description: Add a MonoBehaviour to a GameObject by its (compiled) type name OR by its script asset path. Provide exactly one of 'type' or 'script'. If the type isn't compiled yet, returns a recoverable error: script recompile, poll script recompile_status, then retry.

target.description: Reference to the GameObject to add the component to (globalId/path/guid/instanceId/hierarchyPath).

type.description: Component type name to add, e.g. PlayerController or Game.Player.PlayerController. Must already be compiled. Mutually exclusive with 'script'.

script.description: Script asset path, e.g. 'Assets/Pool/Scripts/CueShooter.cs'. The backing class is resolved via MonoScript.GetClass(), so the class name may differ from the filename. Mutually exclusive with 'type'.

commands.name: create
commands.description: Create a new C# script (default base class MonoBehaviour) from a template under the authoring root. NOTE: the type does not exist until a recompile completes — to attach it, call script recompile, poll script recompile_status, then script attach.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Class/file name without extension, e.g. PlayerController. Must be a valid C# identifier.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Folder (relative to the authoring root; the Assets/ prefix is optional) to write the .cs into. Defaults to the authoring root.

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Optional namespace to wrap the class in. Omit for the global namespace.

parameters.name: base_class
parameters.description: Base class to derive from. Defaults to MonoBehaviour.

parameters.name: overwrite
parameters.description: Overwrite the file if it already exists. Defaults to false (an existing file is an error).

schema.title: script create
schema.description: Create a new C# script (default base class MonoBehaviour) from a template under the authoring root. NOTE: the type does not exist until a recompile completes — to attach it, call script recompile, poll script recompile_status, then script attach.

name.description: Class/file name without extension, e.g. PlayerController. Must be a valid C# identifier.

path.description: Folder (relative to the authoring root; the Assets/ prefix is optional) to write the .cs into. Defaults to the authoring root.

namespace.description: Optional namespace to wrap the class in. Omit for the global namespace.

base_class.description: Base class to derive from. Defaults to MonoBehaviour.

overwrite.description: Overwrite the file if it already exists. Defaults to false (an existing file is an error).

commands.name: recompile
commands.description: Force a script recompile (works while unfocused/minimized). Poll script recompile_status for completion.

parameters.name: focus
parameters.description: If true, bring the Editor to the foreground before compiling. Off by default.

commands.name: recompile_status
commands.description: Get the status of the last recompile: idle | triggered | compiling | completed | up_to_date.
